prompt: Create an ultra-detailed anime fashion editorial portrait inspired by retro pop art and contemporary Japanese character illustration. Depict a stylish young woman with fair skin, a sleek jet-black chin-length bob, bold glossy red lips, and large round silver sunglasses with deep red-tinted lenses. She wears oversized silver over-ear headphones, a fitted red ribbed mock-neck knit top, and a sculptural white shoulder accent. Pose her in a relaxed three-quarter profile while looking confidently toward the viewer. Use a clean solid crimson-red studio background with soft diffused lighting, crisp cel shading, elegant linework, vivid color contrast, premium editorial composition, and ultra-detailed 8K illustration quality.

promptZh: 创作一张超精细的动漫时尚大片肖像，灵感源自 复古波普艺术与当代日本角色插画。描绘一位皮肤白皙、留着利落 乌黑下巴长度波波头 的时尚年轻女性，她有着大胆的亮红色嘴唇，佩戴着深红色镜片的大号圆形银色墨镜。她戴着超大款银色头戴式耳机，身穿修身的 红色罗纹半高领针织衫，肩部带有雕塑感的白色装饰。让她以放松的四分之三侧脸姿态示人，自信地看向镜头。使用干净的纯深红色摄影棚背景，配合柔和的漫射光、清晰的赛璐珞阴影、优雅的线条、鲜明的色彩对比、高级的时尚构图以及超精细的 8K 插画质量。
